title: MRI-Driven Dual-Energy CT Synthesis via Conditional Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models for MRI-only Radiotherapy and Protontherapy
abstract: arXiv:2611.28294v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) provides excellent soft-tissue contrast without ionizing radiation but lacks the electron-density information needed for radiotherapy dose calculation. Dual-energy computed tomography (DECT) improves tissue characterization and stopping-power ratio (SPR) estimation for proton therapy, but requires additional radiation exposure. We developed a denoising diffusion probabilistic model (DDPM) to synthesize high- and low-energy CT (sHECT and sLECT) simultaneously from a single MRI scan. Retrospective paired MRI-DECT data from patients receiving head-and-neck proton therapy were used to train and evaluate a multi-decoder DDPM with SwinViT or ResUNet denoisers. Performance was compared with Pix2PixGAN and CycleGAN using image-quality metrics, Hounsfield unit (HU) errors, anatomical profiles, and SPR maps and uncertainties. translated_title: 基于条件去噪扩散概率模型的MRI驱动双能CT合成，用于纯MRI放疗与质子治疗
translated_abstract: 磁共振成像（MRI）在无电离辐射的情况下能提供出色的软组织对比度，但缺乏放疗剂量计算所需的电子密度信息。双能计算机断层扫描（DECT）可改善组织表征和质子治疗的阻止本领比（SPR）估计，但需要额外的辐射暴露。我们开发了一种去噪扩散概率模型（DDPM），可从单次MRI扫描同时合成高能和低能CT（sHECT和sLECT）。研究使用接受头颈部质子治疗患者的回顾性配对MRI-DECT数据，训练并评估了采用SwinViT或ResUNet去噪器的多解码器DDPM。通过图像质量指标、Hounsfield单位（HU）误差、解剖剖面以及SPR图谱和不确定性，将该方法与Pix2PixGAN和CycleGAN进行了性能比较。结果显示，DDPM在视觉保真度上优于两种生成对抗网络基线方法（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于条件去噪扩散概率模型的多解码器方法，可从单次MRI扫描同时合成高能和低能CT图像，在视觉保真度和SPR估计方面优于GAN基线方法，从而实现无需额外辐射暴露的纯MRI放疗和质子治疗剂量计算。
